description: This file defines a React component 'MultiPosition' for handling multi-element position adjustments (x or y) in an Excalidraw-based drawing application. It includes functions for moving individual elements or groups, and manages user interactions via drag inputs.

methods.name: moveElements
methods.description: Moves individual elements based on property ('x' or 'y') and change in position, applying rotation and position adjustments.

methods.name: moveGroupTo
methods.description: Moves a group of elements to a specified (x, y) position, maintaining relative offsets.

methods.name: handlePositionChange
methods.description: Handles user input for position changes, updating element positions accordingly and triggering scene updates.

methods.name: MultiPosition
methods.description: React component that displays and manages position input (X or Y) for multiple selected elements or groups.
